Only argv[i][0]=="/", argv[i][1]=="s", and isdigit(argv[i][2]) set it to argv[i][2]-'0'; later valid /sN overrides earlier/config values; trailing chars are ignored.

selector_semantics.automatic: f_293A_0006 probes table entries 8 down through 1, returning the first truthy index or 0. f_277E_0000 then checks that returned mode; entry 0 is f_293A_0029 (true), so default 0 is retained.
selector_semantics.zero: Explicit /s0 returns from f_00DF_0004 before sound init; automatic detection returning 0 still calls f_277E_0000(0,0).
selector_semantics.seven: Mode 7 skips the detector-table call; it still indexes setup/cleanup tables at 7.
selector_semantics.one_through_eight: In-range explicit selectors call detector[index]; false falls back to 1, true retains index, then setup[index] and saved-state word zero are used.
selector_semantics.nine: No upper-bound check exists. Explicit /s9 enters f_277E_0000(9,0) after main’s sound DB call returns; detector[9] is an out-of-bounds far call. Its result is not source-closed.
